data.text:
You are Alex. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Kit and Blair.
Your character: Monk (Townsfolk, good team): Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

You are Blair. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Alex and Casey.
Your character: Scarlet Woman (Minion, evil team): If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon.
The Demon is Frankie. Your fellow Minion: Drew (you do not know which Minion characters).

You are Casey. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Blair and Drew.
Your character: Empath (Townsfolk, good team): Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbours are evil.

You are Drew. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Casey and Ellis.
Your character: Spy (Minion, evil team): Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
The Demon is Frankie. Your fellow Minion: Blair (you do not know which Minion characters).

You are Ellis. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Drew and Frankie.
Your character: Ravenkeeper (Townsfolk, good team): If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.

You are Frankie. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Ellis and Gray.
Your character: Imp (Demon, evil team): Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
Your Minions: Blair, Drew (you do not know which Minion characters). Three good characters not in play, for evil to bluff: Washerwoman, Fortune Teller, Investigator.

You are Gray. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Frankie and Harper.
Your character: Chef (Townsfolk, good team): You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are (evil players sitting next to each other).

You are Harper. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Gray and Indigo.
Your character: Mayor (Townsfolk, good team): If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

You are Indigo. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Harper and Jules.
Your character: Saint (Outsider, good team): If you die by execution, your team loses.

You are Jules. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Indigo and Kit.
Your character: Librarian (Townsfolk, good team): You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)

You are Kit. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo, Jules, Kit (and back to Alex). You sit between Jules and Alex.
Your character: Soldier (Townsfolk, good team): You are safe from the Demon.

Night 1 — Chef: You learn that there are 0 pairs of evil players sitting next to each other.
